comments.value: How can you be harassed by receiving vrc+? This confuses me lol.

@{5b0e261a56dd3e28e01af94c|full_name}: One reason could be, that when you add more than 25 favorite avatars then you can't access them anymore unless you purchase VRC+ again.
In order to prevent that people just don't get it, so they will not have to deal with those possible problems.

@{5b0e261a56dd3e28e01af94c|full_name}: Some people will have a reaction of "Thanks for the free gift," but it's important to keep in mind that gifting can be used as a form of harassment. A stalker sending unwanted gifts would be an example of this.

Some people are also uncomfortable because they may either not know the person gifting it well enough, believe (or know) the gifter cannot afford such an expense and giving such a gift is beyond their means, is uncomfortable being given gifts in general, or feel that the gift is being given with expectations of unreasonable recompense/strings attached that they did not and do not intend to agree to.   The latter of which ties into the harassment issue.  These are all examples I've heard from friends who find these to be legitimate concerns either presently or potentially in the future.

I have met quite a few people that were gifted vrchat+ and didn't want it, but had no way to decline it. Two were bought it literally just to be mocked then for having it. people really be spending their money to bother others.

@{5b0e261a56dd3e28e01af94c|full_name}: One of the main reason I see is from the increased rank upon getting VRC+. Some players feel this is unfair towards players that have worked day and night to reach trusted, just for someone else to get a high rank from spending a bit of money (me included, though I do not mock people with VRC+)

be surprised if the ability to decline is added....to a game thats still Alpha and not even BETA release ..... they are likely not gonna add that.
 " That is money to be Made "
@{5d100f3eb716313272a55e89|full_name}: Yeah man this game that's been on steam for about 5 years and that has existed since before then and has over 100million dollars in funding is certainly alpha.

@{61c654278c7ca562c2ae4913|full_name}: I'd have to disagree. Trust is something you gain by being trustworthy. Part of what makes you less likely to be a troll/bot/burner account is spending money on that account. Doing so means you have more to lose should you be banned. The trust system is not a game-style xp system to measure your worth against others, it's a system that determines how likely you are to be a troll. And gifting operates in the same way - if someone trusts you enough in VRC to spend money on you, you're probably not a troll, and should have more of your avi features shown/be able to upload via the SDK.

It's good that VRChat Inc, makes a profit, but I wouldn't be very happy to receive something that I personally don't feel is beneficial.

It's a gift, but I wonder what it's like to be forced to receive it. I want the option to decline. It will be profitable for VRChat, but I would like you to consider the feelings of users.

A gift was dropped while i was distracted recalibrating my tracking. I am not sure why it should be able to be interacted with while the calibration screen is up. This seems like a big bug! I was not the intended recipient and could not decline it. 

I solved the problem by paypalling the amount so they could try again, but I did not need the extra month. I already bought it for myself during the Black Friday sale.

 If i could have declined it would have been far less awkward.
Yeah this, I have PTSD reasons of why I dont like recieving gifts.

Please for the love of god give us this feature. It absolutely is harassment when someone can throws money at you, which you can't decline then acts like you owe them something. "Just block them or tell them off" that's not how it works in a larger community. Steam requires accepting gifts why not vrc? Just throw their money back into their own subscription.
this is a non issue. go seek therapy instead.

details: An interesting scenario popped up where a user claimed another user harassed them by buying them VRC+ when they decided they did not want VRC+ on their account. Currently, it forces you to accept the VRC+ gift.
title: Ability to decline VRChat+ when gifted
